title: Sort rotations, then keep one column
hook: Repeated letters still need different addresses during inversion.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Invert a Burrows-Wheeler transform with stable first-last occurrence mapping and a unique terminator.

misconception: Keeping only the last column of sorted rotations loses the original text.
objective: Invert a Burrows-Wheeler transform with stable first-last occurrence mapping and a unique terminator.

claims.text: Equal letters keep their occurrence order between the first and last columns. That stable rank identifies the predecessor row. Following these links from the terminator reconstructs the text backward without storing the original rotations.
